bodyHtml:
Gumtree for Business

Gumtree for Business is a site dedicated to helping its business users.

This was one of my first times working on a commercial WordPress website for a client. It’s always interesting to see how other developers tackle the problems that arise during the process. I think it’s important to see how other people approach problems as it can make you better at finding the best solution for the task at hand. The site is built with WordPress, it uses Bootstrap and SCSS for the styling. My tasks for this ongoing project was to edit and create new pages, create and update existing modules to be used across the site.

A direct link to the website can be found here at https://www.gumtreeforbusiness.co.uk/.
